profile.name: Caterpillar, Inc.
profile.description: Backed by one of the largest independent global dealer networks and financing services through Cat Financial, the company's primary business segments: Power & Energy, Construction Industries and Resource Industries are solving customers' toughest challenges through commercial excellence and advanced technology, driven by a highly skilled, dedicated global team.

filingRisks.title: Financial and liquidity risk
filingRisks.detail: The filing reports that failure to maintain its credit ratings could increase its cost of borrowing and could adversely affect its cost of funds, liquidity, competitive position and access to capital markets.
evidence: Failure to maintain our credit ratings could increase our cost of borrowing and could adversely affect our cost of funds, liquidity, competitive position and access to capital markets.
Changes in interest rates or market liquidity conditions could adversely affect Cat Financial's and our earnings and/or cash flow.

filingRisks.title: Macroeconomic conditions and demand
filingRisks.detail: The filing reports that commodity price volatility may be abrupt and unpredictable in response to global economic conditions, government actions, regulatory changes, supply/demand dynamics, innovation, and commodity substitutions among others.
evidence: Commodity price volatility may be abrupt and unpredictable in response to global economic conditions, government actions, regulatory changes, supply/demand dynamics, innovation, and commodity substitutions among others.

Market volatility, changes in counterparty credit risk, the impact of government intervention in financial markets and general economic conditions may also adversely impact our ability to access capital and credit markets to fund operating needs.

filingRisks.title: Supply chain and operations
filingRisks.detail: The filing reports that those measures could impact all or portions of its workforce and operations and the operations of its customers, dealers and suppliers.
evidence: Those measures could impact all or portions of our workforce and operations and the operations of our customers, dealers and suppliers.

Production challenges at suppliers (including suppliers of semiconductors), a disruption in deliveries to or from suppliers or decreased availability of raw materials or commodities could have an adverse effect on our ability to meet our commitments to customers or increase our operating costs.

filingRisks.title: People and execution
filingRisks.detail: The filing reports that commodity price changes, material price increases, fluctuations in demand for its products and services, significant disruptions to its supply chains or significant shortages of labor and material may adversely impact its financial results or its ability to meet commitments to customers.
evidence: Commodity price changes, material price increases, fluctuations in demand for our products and services, significant disruptions to our supply chains or significant shortages of labor and material may adversely impact our financial results or our ability to meet commitments to customers.
we may fail to retain, motivate and integrate key management and other employees of the acquired business;.

filingRisks.title: Competition and innovation
filingRisks.detail: The filing reports that actions that lead the currency exchange rate of a country where the company manufacture products to increase relative to other currencies could reduce the competitiveness of products made in that country, which could adversely affect its competitive position, results of operations and financial condition.
evidence: Actions that lead the currency exchange rate of a country where we manufacture products to increase relative to other currencies could reduce the competitiveness of products made in that country, which could adversely affect our competitive position, results of operations and financial condition.
We operate in a highly competitive environment, which could adversely affect our sales and pricing.

filingRisks.title: International and geopolitical exposure
filingRisks.detail: The filing reports that furthermore, embargoes and sanctions imposed by the U.S. and other governments restricting or prohibiting sales to specific persons or countries or based on product classification may expose the company to potential criminal and civil sanctions.
evidence: Furthermore, embargoes and sanctions imposed by the U.S. and other governments restricting or prohibiting sales to specific persons or countries or based on product classification may expose us to potential criminal and civil sanctions.
Violations of anti-corruption laws or regulations by our employees, intermediaries acting on our behalf, or our joint venture partners may result in severe criminal or civil sanctions.

filingRisks.title: Regulation and legal exposure
filingRisks.detail: The filing reports that in addition, data the company collect, store and process are subject to a variety of U.S. and international laws and regulations, such as the European Union's General Data Protection Regulation and the California Consumer Privacy Act, which may carry significant potential penalties for noncompliance.
evidence: In addition, data we collect, store and process are subject to a variety of U.S. and international laws and regulations, such as the European Union's General Data Protection Regulation and the California Consumer Privacy Act, which may carry significant potential penalties for noncompliance.
We are subject to a variety of legal proceedings and legal compliance risks in virtually every part of the world.

filingRisks.title: Transactions and strategy
filingRisks.detail: The filing reports that the company may not realize all of the anticipated benefits of its acquisitions, joint ventures or divestitures, or these benefits may take longer to realize than expected.
evidence: We may not realize all of the anticipated benefits of our acquisitions, joint ventures or divestitures, or these benefits may take longer to realize than expected.
Failure to implement our acquisition strategy, including successfully integrating acquired businesses, could have an adverse effect on our business, financial condition and results of operations.
